notes.title: First Update Live!
notes.notes:
We have received a ton of great feedback, including a few bug reports and many feature requests. We've been working hard to try to include as many fixes and feature requests as possible in this update!

New Content & Features

 E.A.R.L. Letters: Find and collect the E.A.R.L. letters scattered throughout each environment! Search the map and use the environment to gather all four letters in a single run and you’ll be rewarded with coins and a brand-new vehicle. Unlock the new vehicles once per environment.
 Steam Achievements: 19 Steam achievements are ready and waiting to be earned! Where possible, the game will check on startup whether any have been previously completed and automatically award them.
 View Current Build: See which upgrades your vehicle has during and after each run by checking the pause and results menus. Some vehicles start with perks, so now it’s more obvious!
 Trophies: Each level has three trophies that can be earned: Silver, Gold, and Platinum. Beat each level once on Casual, Gnarly, and Insane respectively to earn the trophies. Collect the same trophy for all environments and earn a celebration from Edna… and maybe an achievement.
 Coin Hints: When earning extra coins for things like collecting the E.A.R.L. letters, a hint shows up near the coin balance indicating how many coins you earned.
 Starting Vehicle Upgrades: Some vehicles now start with wheel spikes or extra boost upgrades!


Bugs & Polish

 Fixed: Only the first boss you play against has their pre-run cutscene play
 Fixed: Missing localization text on one of the vehicle colors
 Fixed: Units stop spawning on the Moab Desert and Frozen Salt Flats levels 2 minutes after the boss is spawned
 Fixed: After picking an in-run upgrade, if you quickly press Pause, the game resumes playing even though the Pause Menu is up
 Fixed: UI hover sounds play even when buttons are disabled
 Added: Icons in the Level-Up Upgrade popup
 Added: New voice SFX for bosses


Hope you enjoy!

Colter, Dave, and Ed
